title: How job postings become education predictions
desc: Job postings pass through an extraction cascade in three tiers: rules first, then a fine-tuned NER encoder, then an LLM for what the first two leave. The encoder is a student distilled from an LLM teacher, built on a ModernBERT backbone that was chosen by domain-adaptive pretraining and is served with FP8 and FlashAttention-2 on RTX 5090s. The extracted sections feed downstream classifiers, whose education predictions are checked by an LLM acting as judge.
